Mine started about 2.5 decades ago, when I was just a little kid. I grew up poor and sometimes there wouldn't be food in the house for days. When food came, there was no portioning. I realized that if I didn't eat more than my fill, someone else would eat it. I tried hiding food but someone always found it and ate it. That's when I started binge eating, because if I didn't eat it at that time then I would never get to eat it.

The purging came later, after my obese ass decided to get fit. I never considered it an eating disorder, just that I was being proactive in "negating calories". I felt like I discovered a life hack; I could eat what I wanted without having to pay the price for it. As I became healthier, this widely subsided, but it came out again in Marine Corps boot camp.

The restricting and purging multiple times a day started after I became disabled. I felt I was allergic to everything and losing my mind. There were periods where I would stop eating for two weeks, and the longest was four (I began collapsing).
